messages:
maria: Heads-up: seeing p99 latency laddering on eu-dedicated after the 03:00 canary. p50 stable, p99 +200ms, throughput down ~18%.
ashok: :eyes: which deploy id / pool? any obvious errors in logs?
maria: deploy-bot posted deploy 2028.03.15-03:00 -> model-runtime v2.3.0 to eu-dedicated-pool-3
jin: pulling profiler now, one quick flame:
jin: ```
# simplified top stacks from pprof
kernel_select() -> batch_builder::flush_if() -> kv_cache::lookup_network
batcher::build -> batch_queue::pop -> kernel_dispatch
# shows kernel_select hotpath and kv cache interactions
```
ashok: interesting — kernel_select seems to prefer the small-seq kernel for a chunk of requests that actually have long KV-backed contexts. kernel-switch overhead + cache verification roundtrips = extra wall time.
maria: kv hit-rate jumped from ~12% pre-deploy to ~48% after v2.3.0 rollout on that pool (per Console metrics).
eva: also seeing a noisy tenant: tenant-id noisy-tenant-42 had a sudden burst of long-context requests and is pinned across many slots. eviction didn't kick because packing/quota looked full.
jin: I dumped placement config and found a mismatch: `tenant_quota_fraction = 0.8` for eu dedicated pools — we intended 0.6 in the HA packing policy. that means tenants can reserve more slots and reduce headroom.
ashok: that explains saturation and the noisy-neighbor amplification. Two effects combined: (1) kernel selection heuristic got skewed by more heterogeneous sequence-length distribution; (2) batcher heuristics started producing smaller batches while KV cache warmed, increasing per-token overhead.
maria: propose immediate actions: (A) revert runtime v2.3.0 on eu-dedicated-pool-3 (B) patch placement config to the correct tenant_quota_fraction (C) run targeted eviction on noisy-tenant-42 (D) temporarily tighten max_batch_delay from 8ms -> 4ms to favor batching stability.
eva: I'm patching placement now to 0.6 and will trigger eviction. running: `placementctl set --pool eu-dedicated-pool-3 --tenant_quota_fraction 0.6`
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: runtime v2.3.0 -> v2.2.9 on eu-dedicated-pool-3 (job 98765)
jin: uploaded a perf trace and the pprof bundle to S3: s3://redwood-perf/1825000000-kv-batch-trace.tar.gz
eva: eviction running: `placementctl evict --tenant noisy-tenant-42 --pool eu-dedicated-pool-3`
ashok: short-term mitigation idea: add a quick guard to kernel_selector to prefer the sequence-stable kernel when `kv_hit_rate > 30%` to avoid oscillation until we fix heuristics formally. low-risk stopgap.
maria: agreed. jin, can you open a micro-PR for that guard + an integration test simulating a kv-hit spike?
jin: on it — will include a reproducer and test vector.
eva: eviction finished, slots freed. metrics show throughput recovering, p99 trending down. :thumbsup: 
maria: noted SLA impact: p99 SLA breached for ~32 minutes during the incident window. I'm looping in customer-success to prep comms.
jin: follow-up items: (1) add test for kernel/batcher/kv interplay (2) audit placement defaults across regions (3) long-term fix for kernel selection ML model.
maria: I'll draft postmortem once metrics fully stabilize. root cause (short): placement quota misconfig + kernel-selection heuristic exposed by a KV-cache hit spike caused by a noisy tenant burst.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2028-0453
maria: closing once PR merged and p99 < SLA for 1 hour :white_check_mark:
